Summit Hotels & Resorts celebrates the Holiday Season with a series of Christmas Tree Lighting Events and Great Room Deals.
Summit Tree Lighting
Christmas is the season of giving. Before 2018 comes to a close, create memorable and meaningful memories as you celebrate the holidays with the less fortunate at Summit Hotels. Witness the lighting of Summit’s Signature Christmas Trees on November 8 at Summit Hotel Tacloban and on November 17 at Summit Ridge Tagaytay and Summit Galleria Cebu. Soak in the lively atmosphere with the kids and participate in various activities such as Cookie Decorating Workshop, Puppet Show, Choir Caroling and Ballet Shows.
Relax at Summit Hotel Tacloban for an exclusive Super Gift
For those who plan to stay at Summit Hotel Tacloban for the coming holidays, a Super Exclusive Gift awaits. For only ₱3,200.00nett, you can avail of a Gift Card allowing you to enjoy a stay at their Super Rooms and have a cozy breakfast for 2 with your loved ones. Take advantage of this special offer valid ‘till February 28, 2019.
Summit Birthday Promo
Spoil yourself on your special day with Summit’s Birthday Promo. Book a room at any Summit Hotels on your birthday and you may get a second consecutive night or a bonus room for free! You may opt to book either a package of 1 Room for 2 nights or 2 rooms for 1 night. Just present your valid ID showing the date of your birthday to avail of the promo. Avail of Summit’s birthday gift from December 1, 2018 to December 31, 2019.
